//: Zone sources are NOT covered by tsconfig.json (its `include` is src/app + src/components only), so a zone file is typechecked only where a route transitively imports it. That gap has shipped render-time ReferenceErrors to production repeatedly — `Video is not defined`, `calculateLevelFromXp`, `isMsgAdmin`. This config exists purely so `bun run guard:zones` can catch that one class of error before a build.
